items.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
items.text: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

items.title: Nach Huang-Affäre: Bald alles neu in der KI-Chipindustrie?
